decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door sits in the firm's core industrial door range, remained listed through 2019 while the garage-sector launches were cut, and gives no sign of a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, so a large firm with slack keeps it.

Insulated glazed industrial doors match rising demand for energy efficiency and regulatory compliance in commercial buildings, so results likely meet aspirations and give no reason to redirect the resources.

Having its own dedicated page in both observed years signals that management sees this as a satisfactory product, and with stable performance in a core segment there is no trigger for search or divestment.
